decisions.reason: After four years, this incremental quarter-pallet display should have revealed its demand, and with no later visibility its remaining option value as a distinct product looks limited.
Although it fits existing capabilities well, the pegboard-back variant appears to offer too little unique upside by 2022 to justify keeping it as a separate marketed option.
The eighth-pallet format has had enough time to prove commercial traction, and absent later evidence the firm would likely reallocate resources to core lines and newer developments.
